course_overview.title: Geometry Mastery: Circles & Coordinates
learning_objectives: Master the properties and formulas of circles (radius, diameter, circumference, area)
Understand relationships between angles, arcs, and sectors
Apply coordinate geometry formulas for distance, midpoint, and slope

modules.why_it_matters: Circles are fundamental shapes in engineering, architecture, and nature.
notes_coverage: Key Parts (Center, Radius, Diameter, Chord, Tangent)

interactive_experiences.name: Circle Calculator & Quiz
what_user_does: Inputs a radius value to see instant calculations
Answers a check-for-understanding question about diameter
what_user_sees: Dynamic results for Area and Circumference
Immediate feedback on the quiz question
interactive_experiences.success_signal: Green checkmarks and correct numerical values

checkpoint_questions.question: If diameter is 18, what is the radius?
checkpoint_questions.feedback_correct: Correct! Radius is half the diameter.

boss_challenge.prompt: A circular track has a radius of 10 meters. Calculate the distance around it (Circumference) and the space inside it (Area). Use π ≈ 3.14.
boss_challenge.auto_check_strategy: Check if inputs match expected values within margin of error

youtube.why_this_video: Excellent visual introduction to basic circle concepts.

modules.why_it_matters: Understanding how angles relate to circle segments is key for advanced geometry and trigonometry.

interactive_experiences.name: Sector Solver
what_user_does: Inputs radius and angle in degrees
Calculates arc length and sector area
what_user_sees: Computed values for Arc Length and Sector Area
common_mistakes: Confusing Arc Length with Sector Area

checkpoint_questions.question: If a central angle is 90°, what fraction of the circle is the sector?
checkpoint_questions.feedback_wrong: Think about 90 degrees out of a full 360.

boss_challenge.prompt: An inscribed angle intercepts an arc of 80°. What is the measure of the inscribed angle?
hints: Inscribed angles are half the measure of the intercepted arc.

modules.why_it_matters: Connecting algebra and geometry allows us to analyze shapes on a grid.

interactive_experiences.name: Coordinate Power Tool
what_user_does: Inputs coordinates for two points (x1,y1) and (x2,y2)
Clicks buttons to calculate Distance, Midpoint, or Slope
interactive_experiences.success_signal: Values update correctly based on inputs

checkpoint_questions.question: What is the slope of a horizontal line?
checkpoint_questions.feedback_wrong: Think about the rise. It doesn't rise.

youtube.why_this_video: Comprehensive one-shot overview of coordinate geometry.

layout_rules: Cards should have 16px padding on mobile, 24px on desktop
Grid layout for key points (1 column mobile, 2 columns desktop)
interaction_rules: Input fields should auto-trigger calculation on button click
Feedback for quizzes should be immediate and inline (green/red text)
Avoid alerts; use DOM manipulation to show results
accessibility_rules: All inputs must have associated labels
Buttons must have distinct hover/active states
Color contrast ratios must meet WCAG AA
